entries.text: The Overload lifts every tower at once, and charges a life at the end of every wave it is up
The potion that slows prayer drain is the real Prayer regeneration potion, brewed from a Super restore at 84
A plot's ripe glow and its countdown stay inside their own tile instead of sitting over whatever you built above it
The Herblore bench brews nineteen real OSRS potions, and each one only lifts the towers of its own style
Every tip, hint and boss caption now reads like a line somebody wrote
A tower's panel now names the herbs and potions boosting it, beside its prayers
Drinking a herb or potion that is already running now asks you to confirm first
Herbs stack like potions now, so a second one rides the wave alongside the first instead of replacing it
Traps are back to inventory size in the Hunter page instead of stretching across the row
The DPS and Skills stones swapped places on the bar
Herbs go into a pouch now, and a Herblore bench brews them into potions that last several waves
A Skills stone on the bar now gathers Hunter and Farming in one place
Allotments can be picked up and moved for free, and you can buy as many more as you can afford
The volume slider comes out of the mute button again, as a flyout above the bar
Seeds now count the waves you actually fight, so jumping waves in the debug menu no longer ages them
The volume slider now waits under the mute button until you hover it
An allotment now looks like one — raked soil with your own seed growing in it, and you can dig it up
The road's slide grips move the road again — almost every one of them was refusing to budge
Dawn no longer doubles back over a road leg you shifted
The map now deals allotments — sow a seed between waves and the herb it grows buffs the whole next one
A third signature amulet drops from bosses, and every signature now scales with the tower wearing it
The Collection Log now keeps a Forge page listing every fusion, what two towers make it and how many you have built
An archer and a tzhaar fuse into a thrown dart that shoves harder with every one that lands
A toxic and a wizard fuse into a staff that hands its venom to every tower standing near it
The moment you earn the forge, the game tells you what it means — two maxed towers side by side become one weapon
Every tower now tells you what it can be forged into, before you own either half
A tzhaar and a toxic fuse into a halberd that swings at everything in reach and smears the worst venom across all of it
An archer and a cannon fuse into a bow whose shot runs the whole road, hitting everyone on it
A silenced tower now wears the spell's impact, not its orb — blood runs down it and smoke curls off it
A tower an acolyte silenced now wears that Ancient's own spell, looping over it
Nex's acolytes now silence within a second and a half of arriving, and reach out every 4s instead of 6.5s
A tower silenced by one of Nex's acolytes now wears that element, and each acolyte calls out when your board has none of its own
A 0 over an enemy now says which kind of nothing it was
A wizard and a slayer fuse into a staff that hits dying enemies harder and stops anything healing
Two finished towers can now be forged into one weapon they could never be apart
The damage meter now breaks out every tower's own signature
The road slides too — grab a stretch by its grip to straighten a bend or grow one back
Shorter 'how to kill' lines on every boss
Each of Nex's acolytes silences every tower casting its own Ancient
The Beast's cores leap onto whatever is hurting him, and one more of them every spit
